description:
The World-class Authoring Tool for eLearning Design

ActivePresenter is a world-class eLearning authoring tool designed for creating professional, interactive content with ease. It supports a range of functionalities, including converting PowerPoint presentations into HTML5 or eLearning formats, building interactive simulations with smart screen-capture technology, and developing assessments or gamified educational experiences without requiring coding skills. The software also offers powerful video recording and editing tools, along with responsive design support for various screen sizes. With its user-friendly interface, ActivePresenter is perfect for creating slide-based courses, interactive simulations, and video-based lessons across different devices, making it a versatile choice for educators and professionals alike.
Bugs Fixed:
- The program may crash when opening the About dialog.
- The program may freeze when previewing all slides on the timeline.
- Project backups may not be created at the specified interval.
- The operator of a variable condition changes to "is equal to" after selecting another variable.
- Embedded YouTube videos cannot generate preview thumbnails in the editor.
- [macOS]: Pressing Enter in the Correct Values field of a Text Entry object generates text-to-speech audio.
- [HTML5]: Graded Essay questions are submitted as soon as the first character is typed.
- [HTML5]: The flipped Spotlight is displayed in the wrong position.
- [HTML5]: The player bar may be pushed out of view after it is hidden and shown again.
- [HTML5]: New learners may see the Resume Presentation prompt in presentations embedded in a Web Object inside an LMS course.
- [xAPI]: Changes made since the last save are lost when the learner closes the page.
- [xAPI]: HTML files of embedded Web Objects are missing from the exported package.
- [SCORM/xAPI]: Exporting may overwrite or delete files in the output folder and leave an unnecessary player folder.
